data.headline: Asbury Park agenda lists a Waterfront Redevelopment Area site plan

claims.text: The Views at Westley Lake is listed as a preliminary and final major site plan in the Waterfront Redevelopment Area.

citation.quote: PB-2026-01 / The Views at Westley Lake / 216 Cookman Avenue / Block 3802, Lot 1 / APW Redeveloper, LLC / Preliminary & Final Major Site Plan / Waterfront Redevelopment Area / Prime Renewal Area

claims.text: STHO states that it is the managing member of Asbury Partners, LLC, the joint venture that owns the Asbury Park Waterfront investment.

citation.quote: We are the managing member in Asbury Partners, LLC, which is the joint venture that owns the Asbury Park Waterfront investment.

claims.text: STHO reported that the Asbury Park Waterfront investment had an aggregate carrying value of approximately $120.9 million as of June 30, 2026.

citation.quote: The aggregate carrying value of the Asbury Park Waterfront investment was approximately $120.9 million as of June 30, 2026.

claims.text: STHO's stated strategy is to monetize remaining development sites and operating assets through sales to third-party developers and operators while meeting its redevelopment agreement obligations.

citation.quote: Our current strategy for the Asbury Park Waterfront investment is to actively asset manage our operating assets, and strategically monetize the remaining development sites and our operating assets through sales to third party developers and operators while meeting our obligations under the redevelopment agreement with the city of Asbury Park.
